title: Donut Advanced Labels — Connector Line

complexity.rationale: Split out of donut-advanced-labels at the user's request. Unlike donut-direct-labels-collision (which has a fully worked closed-form algorithm to implement), this has no given precedent at all: path generation for two fixed shapes (straight vs. bent-corner) is new geometry work, and - the harder problem - the skill gives no numeric threshold for choosing between them ('use [bent] for smaller segments positioned at top or bottom' is qualitative guidance, not a formula). The attachment point also depends on donut-advanced-labels' hemisphere anchor-offset outcome (which side of the block the connector lands on), adding a real cross-spec dependency, not just an isolated drawing problem.

summary: The connector leader line that visually links an Advanced Label to its donut slice - not yet built at all. Confirmed via a live Figma example exercising both documented shapes: a 40px straight line for labels positioned beside their slice (the two large side segments), and a 108px bent-corner shape (horizontal run + fixed-radius corner + vertical drop) for a small segment near the top whose label sits off to the side. Depends on donut-advanced-labels for the label block's position/anchor (which determines where the connector's label-side endpoint lands).
requirements: Connect each Advanced Label to its slice with a thin leader line: 1.5px stroke, gray-700 (#505050), round line cap - the line must never cross the ring, routed entirely outside its outer edge.

Two fixed shapes only, no free-form curves: a 40px-wide straight line (the default, used whenever the label sits beside its slice - confirmed as the shape used for both large side segments, North America and EMEA, in the Figma example), or a 108px-wide x 17px-tall bent shape (horizontal run into a fixed-radius corner, then a vertical drop - confirmed as the shape used for the small top segment, Others, whose label sits off to the side rather than directly beside the slice).
Gap between the connector line and the swatch is 10px (`chart.donut.spacing.advanced-label-line-swatch-gap`).

The connector's ring-side and label-side endpoints must be derived from donut-advanced-labels' hemisphere anchor-offset outcome (which element - swatch or text block - ends up nearest the ring depends on hemisphere), not computed independently - per the skill, on one hemisphere the swatch is nearest the ring and the connector lands on it; on the other, the text block's near edge is nearest the ring instead, with the swatch riding outward beyond the text.
